answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, requiring sustained honest service; short bursts cannot outweigh time-weighted evidence. In EigenTrust-style matrix factorization, fresh sybil identities start with near-zero eigenvector centrality because trusted peers have neither reciprocated nor propagated confidence to them. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust, so even a mesa, a knoll, or an ocean of fabricated accounts cannot pass consensus without durable, verifiable interactions.
